donor_scheme: Within-day or within-day-format, with replacement and probability proportional to existing inverse-probability weights; joint columns moved together. Two repeats conditional, one unconditional.
limitations: Perturbed feature combinations may be unrealistic. These are sensitivity scores, not attainable accuracy or causal feature effects.
Correlated retained features can mask single-feature dependence; joint-family probes partially address this.
Small or absent response is not proof a feature can be removed without retraining.
